Iranian singer and team flogged for performing without hijab

Singer Parastoo Ahmadi and four members of her concert team were flogged in Qom on Monday, according to her lawyer. The punishment, which included 74 lashes each, was for a December 2024 performance that was streamed live without an audience. A court had sentenced nine team members to 74 lashes each, a two-year travel ban, and a two-year ban on artistic activity.
